scope: Build two case-owned Linux scratch images with a local Docker engine and no network. The single-stage baseline carries the synthetic build-only marker into its final image. The multi-stage build copies only the intended static fixture output into its runtime stage. Inspect docker image save archives and apply their layers to compare the actual final filesystems, check the intermediate marker never appears in a final layer, and run the final image without networking to verify its executable can read the allowed payload. This establishes final-image minimization for this synthetic fixture only; production package inventories, build systems, promotion gates, and deployed image scope require separate evidence.

checks.claim: single-stage baseline retains the synthetic build-only marker
built intermediate stage actually contains the synthetic marker
multi-stage final image excludes the build marker and contains only runtime output
The runtime executable reads the intact permitted payload
